headline: Israel plans to limit new data centers to 200 megawatts as AI pushes up demand for electricity, CTech reports.
score_reason: Stays at the pool score: a national power cap on data centers, but only the headline is known.
importance_line: Companies planning data centers in Israel are affected, but whether the 200 megawatts applies per site or in total is not clear.
summary: CTech, the technology news site of Israel's Calcalist newspaper, reports that Israel is to cap new data centers at 200 megawatts amid a power crunch driven by AI.
notes: CTech page returned no readable text; no other outlet found. Headline only; unclear whether the cap is per site or in total.
